operation: Static self-inclusive L2 kNN; return K original IDs and FP32 Euclidean distances to Host

query_sets.rule: Fresh seeded disjoint in-dataset IDs; exclude all P0-P6 query IDs; freeze IVF configuration before final-query creation

oracle: Independent full-table GPU FP64 RN subtract/multiply/add with FMA disabled; deterministic (squared distance, ID) top-K; exact-distance boundary ties also reported
quality_rule: Record deterministic ID Recall@K, exact-boundary-tie-aware Recall@K, per-query recall and distance error; freeze fastest development configuration meeting each anchor per dataset/K/B. No final tuning. Report missed final anchors rather than relabeling them.

gts.adaptation: Separate diagnostic copy: binary FP32 input loader (upstream already uses FP32), MAX_H=6 capacity, fixed 1 GiB query workspace, full sorted-neighbor ID/distance extraction. Preserve original tree construction, pruning, distance arithmetic and sorting.

faiss.backend: Existing P6 source-built Faiss 1.15.1 native GpuIndexIVFFlat; cuVS disabled

scope: Warm static Host-ready query pass; includes host query gather/input transfer, search/sort, native output transfer, conversion to common ID/distance representation, synchronization and per-query allocation/free. Excludes data read, static layout/index build, reference oracle, quality checks and report-file writes; list them separately.

timing.order: GTS/IVF on odd rounds, IVF/GTS on even rounds; alternate dataset and configuration order
timing.estimator: median total ms per 256-query pass; p10/p90; paired process log ratio with fixed-seed bootstrap 95% CI
timing.sustained: The B32 256-query pass is the sustained scope, not isolated-kernel promotion
timing.development_selection_estimator: mean total Host-ready time of the two development passes among configurations meeting the anchor

gpu.permission: User authorizes an idle single GPU, including GPU7, on 2026-10-03
gpu.isolation: Canonical and legacy advisory GPU locks; fresh process admission and monitoring; abort only own process on foreign GPU activity
gpu.do_not_touch: All foreign jobs and GPU0 service; no clock/power changes

gates: synthetic ID extraction/full-table oracle including ties, ragged N and batches
stop_rule: Fail closed on source drift, occupied GPU, incorrect IDs/distances, sanitizer error or legal-capacity failure; preserve every failure. Pilot timeout 1200 s per process. Missing gate or missed quality anchor limits claims; it does not count as a same-quality win.
quality_anchor_metric: exact-boundary-tie-aware ID Recall@K; deterministic-ID recall reported separately
distance_field_tolerance: FP32 output Euclidean distance squared agrees with RN FP64 squared L2 within 5e-5*max(1,squared L2). Also report raw Euclidean absolute/relative errors; near-zero cancellation is not hidden.
